name: Witherbark Tusk
summary: A Witherbark Tusk is a trophy taken from the trolls of southeastern Arathi. Apprentice Kryten needs ten for Archmage Malin’s research at Refuge Pointe.

sections.title: A Troll’s Tusk
sections.body: At Refuge Pointe, Apprentice Kryten gathers reagents for Archmage Malin’s research. The tusks come from Witherbark trolls in the southeastern highlands, where the tribe makes its home. Kryten needs ten, alongside medicine pouches and a shadow hunter’s knife.

faq.answer: Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe needs ten Witherbark Tusks for Archmage Malin’s research.

faq.q: Where do Witherbark Tusks come from?
faq.answer: Witherbark Tusks come from the Witherbark trolls living southeast of Refuge Pointe in Arathi Highlands.

faq.q: Why does Kryten need the tusks?
faq.answer: Kryten is collecting reagents for Archmage Malin’s research, and the tusks are among the items he needs.

faq.q: How many tusks does Kryten need?
faq.answer: Kryten needs ten Witherbark Tusks, along with four medicine pouches and a Shadow Hunter Knife.
